title: MetaMask security incident forces Ethereum staking exits, no funds at risk
summary: Title: MetaMask exits Ethereum validators after attacker diverts staking rewards URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/10/01/metamask-security-incident-forces-ethereum-staking-exits-with-lido-warning-of-lost-rewards Published Time: 2026-10-01T07:06:30.446Z Markdown Content: Updated Oct 1, 2026, 3:30 a.m. EDT Published Oct 1, 2026, 3:06 a.m. EDT 3 min read ![Image 1: MetaMask's mobile app (Gabby Jones)](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F6ef086b18446966ac8edf22c629a6b92f11c0549-1024x683.jpg%3Frect%3D0%2C54%2C1024%2C576%26w%3D1920%26h%3D1080%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75) MetaMask's mobile app (Gabby Jones) Summary * MetaMask began exiting affected Ethereum validators after a security incident diverted an estimated 0.36 ETH in block-production payments, though the company said it found no immediate threat to users’ wallets. * A researcher estimated that about 17,000 validators holding roughly 523,000 ETH were being withdrawn, but MetaMask had not confirmed those figures or explained how its systems were compromised. * Lido said affected validators could miss rewards during an exit and re-entry process lasting up to about 45 days, while stETH holders do not need to take action. MetaMask is pulling Ethereum staking systems out of service after a security incident, with Lido warning of lost rewards and a security researcher reporting that payments from producing blocks were diverted to another wallet. The cryptocurrency wallet provider, which also operates staking services, [disclosed Wednesday](https://metamask.io/news/user-update) that the incident affected part of its infrastructure, adding it exited affected validators — or the computers that help check Ethereum transactions — as a precaution. “At this time, we have identified no immediate threat to MetaMask wallets,” the company said. (Dogecoin) Summary * DogeOS opened a public test network that lets developers build Ethereum-compatible trading, lending and stablecoin applications using test DOGE. * The network initially relies on selected operators, protected hardware and a Security Council, while a proposed Dogecoin Core upgrade would eventually allow Dogecoin miners to verify its proofs. * DogeOS has not set a mainnet launch date and faces questions about demand after weak Dogecoin ETF inflows and the decline of earlier memecoin application networks. DogeOS has opened a public test network for Ethereum-style trading, lending and other applications using DOGE, an attempt to give Dogecoin holders more ways to use their coins beyond payments and price speculation. Per documents shared with CoinDesk, the network launched Wednesday and is Ethereum-compatible, meaning it allows developers to use familiar software to build applications. The trial uses test DOGE to pay transaction fees, with projects developing lending services, trading platforms and a cryptocurrency-backed stablecoin. ## Why dogecoin?
